title.quote: International Network of AI Safety Institutes Mission Statement
The International Network of AI Safety Institutes becomes the International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science

date_published.quote: have gathered today in San Francisco on November 21, 2024 to launch the International Network of AI Safety Institutes

date_last_updated.quote: The meeting confirmed the International Network of AI Safety Institutes’ transition into the International Network for Advanced AI Measurement Evaluation and Science

status.quote: Through this Network, we are dedicated to collaborating broadly with partners to ensure that safe, secure, and trustworthy AI benefits all of humanity.
The UK now takes on a Network Coordinator role as part of the changes

legal_force.quote: The International Network of AI Safety Institutes is intended to be a forum that brings together technical expertise from around the world.

changes.date_published: the statement's own text dates the launch meeting 21 November 2024; the earlier 20 November 2024 comes from a US fact sheet that is not among my stored files, so the instrument's own date is used

judgment.status_reasoning: Mission statement from 2024 still operative; the Network was renamed in Dec 2025 (UK GOV.UK release of 9 Dec 2025) and continues. No withdrawal found in the stored files.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Unchanged; mandate of an international network of AI safety institutes.

open_questions: date_published: the mission statement says 21 November 2024; a US launch fact sheet (not in my files) is said to be released 20 November 2024. A checker should compare both stored sources.
The stored statement does not use the word 'Joint' that the record title has, nor name the US Departments of Commerce and State as launchers (issuing_body); those rest on sources not in my files.
The GOV.UK release says 'Established in November 2024'; the statement text lists 'the European Commission' where the record says 'the EU'.
